High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready copy of the Players Committee virtual card [[Rebellions Are Built On Hope (Errata)]] (Virtual Set 7, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Virtual Cards/Set 7/Light/Rebellions Are Built On Hope.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jaD4bmdNfcwUOMSeClHsB6awydR-ManA/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Rebellions Are Built On Hope.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,340,368 bytes, SHA-256 <code>93c49e16314fbc68abf899e922f3939b0c0c0ab611c2fcd5685ed9c57e30d34b</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:V7-L-rebellionsarebuiltonhope.gif]].

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
